h1: Residency Scheduling Software That Does the Work
paragraph: Go beyond typical residency scheduling software. Scheduling Wizard is a managed service. Provide your rules; we deliver a complete, ACGME-compliant schedule.

cta.title: Get Your Residency Schedules Done Right
cta.description: Book a call to talk through your scheduling needs and learn how Scheduling Wizard works. Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices that have us build their call, block, clinic and shift schedules.

faq.answer: Residency scheduling software helps programs build and manage rotation, call, and clinic schedules for residents. Most tools are self-service platforms that require someone to learn and operate them. Scheduling Wizard is different: it is a managed service, not a self-service platform. Programs submit their rules and receive finished, ACGME-compliant schedules as Excel files. There is no software to learn, no dashboard to manage, and no annual retraining needed when chief residents rotate.
faq.question: What is residency scheduling software and how does Scheduling Wizard differ?

faq.answer: ACGME compliance is built into the schedule as it is created, not manually checked after the fact. Our team has subspecialty-specific ACGME rules built in, including 80-hour weekly limits, minimum rest requirements, and program-specific call rules. Because the rules are built in as the schedule is created, the rules are applied before the schedule reaches your program. This is one of the most common questions asked during sales conversations, and it is a core part of how Scheduling Wizard is built.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard ensure ACGME duty hour compliance?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard generates four types of schedules: Block or rotation schedules, Call schedules with fairness optimization, Clinic schedules, and Attending schedules. All four are built together, so conflicts between schedule types are resolved before the final schedule is delivered. The output is ready-to-use Excel files that programs can upload to their existing publishing platform.
faq.question: What types of schedules does Scheduling Wizard generate for residency programs?

faq.answer: No. Many Scheduling Wizard clients continue using the platform they already have alongside the service. Scheduling Wizard handles schedule creation and optimization, while the platform you already use handles day-to-day schedule viewing and access. The finished Excel files Scheduling Wizard delivers are designed to be uploaded directly into whichever viewing platform your program already uses.
faq.question: Do we need to replace the platform we use now to use Scheduling Wizard?

faq.answer: Your program's rules, requests, and scheduling configurations are retained by Scheduling Wizard year over year. When a new chief resident takes over, they inherit a fully operational, optimized scheduling system instead of starting from scratch. This eliminates one of the most common sources of scheduling disruption in residency programs, where institutional knowledge is lost every time a chief resident rotates out.
faq.question: What happens to our scheduling setup when chief residents change each year?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard works with chief residents, program directors, program coordinators, and GME offices. Chief residents are often the primary point of contact since they are typically responsible for building schedules. Program directors and coordinators are also common contacts, particularly for larger programs or those managing schedules across multiple departments. The managed service model is designed so that no single person needs deep scheduling expertise to get compliant, optimized schedules produced.
